title: Chapter 103 You Are Such A Person
content:
Chapter 103 You Are Such A Person

Faced with Li Gengnian's friendly greeting, Zhang Erhe had no intention of replying.

"Brother Li, I still have something to do now, let's talk about it another day."

Then, without waiting for Li Gengnian to reply, Zhang Erhe continued to go to the city lord's mansion without stopping.

Li Gengnian frowned slightly when he was still there.

Looking at the direction Zhang Erhe was heading, Li Gengnian waved.

The next moment, a figure in black appeared beside him.

"Honor, what are the instructions?"

Li Gengnian said indifferently: "Go and check, what happened to the Zhang family."

"Yes, the head of the family."

Immediately, the figure in black disappeared.

Li Gengnian stood there, but felt a little uneasy.

There is no difference between the Zhang family and his Li family. If anything happens to the Zhang family, then something may happen to the Li family. He cannot follow the footsteps of the Zhang family.

I have to say that Li Gengnian is indeed very thoughtful.

This also laid the foundation for the Li family to gradually become stronger with the Zhang family in the future.

......

The city lord's mansion is in a courtyard.

"Master Lord."

Awei pulled Fan Yingying and came to Lu Daosheng's residence.

"Oh? Awei, what's wrong?"

Seeing Awei, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled, but Yu Guang kept glancing at Fan Yingying beside Awei.

Elf clan?

It looks so young, what is Awei going to do?

"My Lord, a casino has appeared in the deserted city of Wanling Realm, and there are also bad behaviors of trafficking people. My subordinates have arrested all the criminals."

At this time, Awei directly reported what happened in the deserted city of the Wanling Realm to Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression moved slightly.

Casinos, trafficking of people.

This is what he hates the most.

How long has it been since I walked, such a bad thing happened in the deserted city of the Wanling Realm.

Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Awei, you do well. Those who commit crimes don't have to mercy."

However, Awei hesitated: "My Lord, my subordinates have controlled all the criminals and put them in prison, but,

"Just what?"

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

This was the first time Lu Daosheng saw Awei hesitate to do things.

Awei slowly said, "My Lord, the owner of the casino is the son of Zhang's family's advocate Erhe."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned.

Zhang family.

Lu Daosheng is naturally very familiar with the Zhang family.

Before he had just arrived in the deserted city, the Zhang family had helped him a lot.

To be precise, the people of Huangcheng were very good to them at that time. It was also because Lu Daosheng would still take good care of them for so long. He would find ways to divide them with any benefits.

But now, this is a matter of principle.

Seeing Lu Daosheng pondering, Awei also remained silent.

Now that he has reported this matter to Lu Daosheng, it is not something he can decide next.

After all, he knew the help of the Zhang family to Lu Daosheng.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly looked up.

A guard led a middle-aged man towards the place.

"The Zhang family advocated Erhe and met the city lord!"

As soon as he saw Lu Daosheng, Zhang Erhe knelt down directly, and tears continued to flow on his face, fearing that others would not know how much grievance he suffered.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng seemed to have no idea what happened and smiled and said, "Erhe, what happened, I was crying."

Upon hearing this, Zhang Erhe cried even harder and looked up and was about to complain, but when he saw A Wei beside him, his crying suddenly stopped.

Ga~

"Ah, Ah Wei, why are you here too?"

Zhang Erhe pointed at Awei and said in disbelief.

Upon hearing this, Awei just replied indifferently, "I'm just here to report on the work, you can continue."

Hearing this, Zhang Erhe immediately didn't know what to say.

Looking at Zhang Erhe who was not talking, Lu Daosheng smiled in his heart, but said, "Erhe, what happened?"

"Ah? City, Lord City, yes, that's it."

Zhang Erhe wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said guiltily: "My son made something and was imprisoned by Huang Wei. I, I think,,."

"Want me to let your son come out?"

Lu Daosheng said directly.

Upon hearing this, Zhang Erhe hurriedly said, "Mr. City Lord, I will definitely discipline Guangyao well. Guangyao has been weak and sick since he was a child. He can't stay in the prison. I also hope that the City Lord will show his compassion!"

After saying that, Zhang Erhe looked at Lu Daosheng with hope.

Hearing Zhang Erhe's words, Lu Daosheng smiled, and then his expression suddenly became cold.

"Do you know, what did your son do?!"

Lu Daosheng said with anger.

Open a casino and sell human beings.

If this is something that happened outside, he would not care about it and would not say anything, but this is a deserted city, his deserted city, then such things are absolutely not allowed to happen.

What's more, he has already issued strict regulations on these things.

Zhang Erhe's son Zhang Guangyao dared to know the law and violated the law. He relied on his identity as the Zhang family and did whatever he wanted, so he didn't take him seriously.

Seeing Lu Daosheng so angry.

Zhang Erhe lowered his head tightly, not daring to breathe.

To be honest, he really doesn't know what Zhang Guangyao did.

Since childhood, he has been spoiled by Zhang Guangyao and he will not object to anything he does.

But I didn't expect that it would be like this now.

Looking at Zhang Erhe who was at a loss, Lu Daosheng said coldly: "Awei, tell Erhe what good things his son has done."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

After a while, Zhang Erhe sat on the ground with a pale face.

His face gradually became desperate.

Casinos, and it is also related to human trafficking.

But just opening a casino is enough to have nine lives on Zhang Guangyao.

"City, Lord,"

Zhang Erhe looked up at Lu Daosheng with tears in his face.

However, Lu Daosheng turned his head directly.

"Erhe, go back. Your son deserves his guilt and cannot be treated lightly."

Finally, Zhang Erhe walked out of the city lord's mansion in a daze.

His own son is gone.

What did he explain to his wife?

In the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

In An Xing's report, he had known for a long time that the big families in the deserted city had begun to become a little dishonest over the years.

After all, the family is big and the business is big, and the top management cannot be foolproof in the control of the subordinates.

So he had already been preparing to hit these big families.

Lu Daosheng also has enough trust in An Xing.

But this incident was not done by An Xing, but by A Wei, which surprised him a little.

Could it be that the intelligence capabilities of the root are not as strong as those of Huang Wei?

At this time, Awei on the side said, "Sir, if this is the case, what will Old Zhang say?"

The old man of the Zhang family, although the person who no longer manages the Zhang family's affairs, has given them to future generations, if he learned about this, he would probably not be indifferent.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said indifferently: "Old Zhang will understand my good intentions."

These big families must be shocked.

The one who sacrificed was Zhang Erhe's son.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Fan Yingying beside Awei again.

This guy held Awei's hand tightly from the beginning, without raising his head.

"Awei, who is this?"

Upon hearing this, Awei showed an invisible smile on his face.

Lord, you finally asked a question.

"Yingying, come and meet the city lord."

Awei seemed to show off and pulled Fan Yingying in front of him.

Hearing Awei's words, Fan Yingying nodded obediently, then stepped forward and knelt down to Lu Daosheng.

She didn't know about Lu Daosheng, but the title of Huangcheng City Lord was different.

Now in the world of all spirits, who doesn’t know that the deserted city is the well-deserved overlord.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City is an existence that a small person like her will never reach.

To be able to see the Lord of the Huangcheng City today, it would be a blessing for her to have three lives.

However, at this time, a gentle force dragged her body.

"No need to kneel."

Lu Daosheng said with a faint smile.

Fan Yingying was stunned for a moment, then said to Lu Daosheng: "My name is Fan Yingying, an elf member."

"Oh? Then what's your relationship with Awei?"

Upon hearing this, Fan Yingying said simply: "Awei is my husband."

Puff ~

Lu Daosheng immediately stood up, his face extremely shocked.

Awei behind Fan Yingying was also shocked and hurriedly stepped forward to cover Fan Yingying's little mouth.

"Hmm."

"Sir, the child likes to talk nonsense, don't mind."

Awei said with awkward expression.

However, Lu Daosheng stared at Awei and sneered.

The word husband was told to Awei a long time ago. How could anyone else know this word? Looking at Fan Yingying's simple gaze, Lu Daosheng was a little angry.

"Awei, I didn't expect you to be such a person."

"I didn't even let go of the kids, why didn't I notice it before?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Awei felt a little ashamed.

However, at this time Fan Yingying said weakly: "I am not a child, I am already nineteen years old."
